courses.name: Python Developer
courses.certification: CITI Academy Certificate in Python Programming, awarded on successful completion of practicals, mock tests and the final project.
courses.overview: A hands-on Python course that takes you from your first line of code to job-ready developer skills. Built around practice, not just theory, with real projects, mock tests and interview preparation baked into every stage.
concepts: Python fundamentals: variables, data types, operators
Conditional statements and loops
Functions and reusable code blocks
Lists, tuples, dictionaries and sets
File handling and exception handling
Object-oriented programming in Python
Working with modules and libraries
Basic problem-solving and coding practice
Beginner-to-advanced level progression, one language, endless opportunities
practical: Mini projects at the end of every topic
A capstone project to showcase on your resume
courses.mockInterview: Structured mock interviews with technical and HR-style questions, plus one-on-one feedback before you start applying.
courses.resumePrep: Guided resume building focused on projects, skills and certifications that recruiters actually look for.

courses.name: MS Office Professional
courses.tagline: Word, Excel & PowerPoint for real work
courses.certification: CITI Academy Certificate in MS Office Professional Skills, awarded after practical assessments in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
courses.overview: A practical, project-based course covering the three tools every office and classroom runs on. You will leave able to produce polished documents, working spreadsheets with formulas and dashboards, and presentations that hold a room.
concepts: MS Word: document formatting, page layout, styles, tables, images, headers/footers, mail merge, track changes
MS Word projects: letters, reports, certificates, worksheets, notices
MS Excel: workbook and worksheet basics, data entry and formatting
MS Excel formulas: SUM, AVERAGE, IF, COUNTIF, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP
MS Excel: sorting, filtering, data validation, charts, Pivot Tables and dashboards
MS Excel projects: attendance tracker, marksheet, result analysis, dashboard
MS PowerPoint: slide design, themes, layouts, multimedia, SmartArt, animations and transitions
MS PowerPoint: Slide Master, Presenter View, timings, interactive presentations
Integrated capstone combining Word, Excel and PowerPoint in one project
practical: Real office-style documents, sheets and decks, not just sample files
courses.mockInterview: Guidance on the kind of practical tasks employers test for in office-assistant and back-office interviews.
courses.resumePrep: Help listing your MS Office proficiency and completed projects clearly on a resume.

courses.name: Professional Computer Teacher Training
courses.tagline: Certificate in Computer Applications for Teachers
courses.eligibility: In-service and aspiring school teachers, teacher-training institutes, education staff
courses.certification: Certificate in Professional Digital Teaching, issued on completion of all four modules, the final integrated project and the assessment.
courses.overview: A complete four-module program that turns teachers into confident, tech-enabled classroom professionals: digital office skills, child psychology and communication, foundational programming, and real classroom and interview readiness, trained at a practical-to-theory ratio of 80:20.
concepts: Module 1 - Computer Fundamentals: hardware, memory & storage, operating systems, file management, keyboard shortcuts
Module 1 - MS Office Suite: Word, Excel and PowerPoint for classroom documents, marksheets and lesson presentations
Module 1 - Mail Maintenance: professional email, etiquette, Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Forms, Meet, Classroom)
Module 1 - Networking & Internet: browsers, safe search, cybersecurity basics, cloud storage
Module 1 - Computer Maintenance, printing, scanning and basic image editing
Module 2 - Child Psychology: stages of development, learning styles, classroom-management techniques, inclusive education
Module 2 - Communication Skills: public speaking, active listening, parent-teacher communication, conflict resolution
Module 2 - Personality Development: confidence, body language, time management, emotional intelligence, leadership
Module 3 - Programming Fundamentals: Scratch, HTML, CSS, VS Code, Python and Java basics
Module 3 - Software Fields: web development, app development, data science and AI/ML awareness for guiding students
Module 4 - Teaching Practice: lesson planning, live mock classes, structured feedback
Module 4 - Case Study: classroom observation, learning-gap analysis, intervention planning
practical: A capstone digital lesson package built in Word, Excel and PowerPoint
A simple personal or class webpage built with HTML and CSS
A documented student case study with an improvement plan
A live 15-20 minute mock class combining teaching practice and digital tools
courses.mockInterview: One-on-one and panel mock interviews for teaching roles, with detailed feedback and a final readiness assessment before certification.
courses.resumePrep: A dedicated module on building a professional teaching resume and writing a compelling cover letter, avoiding common resume mistakes.
highlights: Practical exercises, assignments and module tests
Final integrated project and mock interview

courses.name: Hotel Management
courses.tagline: Front office, food & beverage and hospitality skills
courses.certification: CITI Academy Certificate in Hotel Management Fundamentals, awarded after practical assessments and an internship-readiness review.
courses.overview: A foundation course in hospitality operations covering front office, food and beverage service, housekeeping and guest communication, built around practical drills so you walk into an internship or entry-level role already comfortable with the basics.
concepts: Introduction to the hospitality industry and hotel departments
Front office operations: reservations, check-in / check-out, guest handling
Food & beverage service basics and table etiquette
Housekeeping fundamentals and room standards
Grooming, hygiene and professional presentation
Guest communication and complaint handling
Basic hospitality software and billing awareness
courses.mockInterview: Mock interviews focused on hospitality roles, grooming standards and situational guest-handling questions.
courses.resumePrep: Resume building aimed at internships and entry-level hotel and hospitality roles.
